tiers.A: mechanically verified outcome: the candidate was consumed by a real command whose success depends on it being the requested value
tiers.B: explicit user confirmation or correction, carrying rejection and acceptance
tiers.C: authoritative source-native relation (git ref -> commit), verified against the live authority at mining time
tiers.D: assistant narration or critic inference -- COUNTED, never written to truth

protocol.question_source: verbatim real user turn; never derived from the answer
protocol.truth_source: the tier relation only; never the assistant's wording
protocol.ambiguity: one question with several equally consumed candidates is emitted to the ambiguity bucket, not to ground truth
protocol.artifact_match: a candidate must share a distinctive term with the artifact the question names, and for PATH that term must appear in the candidate's own basename
protocol.success_receipt: a command counts as consumed only if its own output shows success; `-> exit N` (N>0), `exit code: N`, `command not found`, `No such file` and non-2xx HTTP status all disqualify
protocol.determinism: fixed input store; dataset_sha256 covers the emitted rows in order
